transfer_id.description: Stable name of one transfer; every operation re-proves the registry state against this record (DT section 5.2 steps 2/6/7).

destination_target_id.description: May equal or differ from source_target_id - target ids are per-root (DT section 1 invariant 2).

destination_repository_aliases.description: Canonical coordinates (never SSH aliases) the destination keeps as alias history - at minimum the source coordinates when the remote moved.

source_approved_by.description: The person approving the release for the source root - a human act, typed by that person.

destination_approved_by.description: The person approving for the destination root; both owners confirm when they are different people (step 2).

confirmed_transfer_not_fork_or_mirror.description: Step 2 confirmation: this is a transfer of one repository, not a fork/mirror being registered as a new Target.

status.description: Mechanical ledger of the flow (pending -> released -> completed, or released -> rolled_back); written by the flow's operations, never in place of a human approval.
